title: Mbappé v Henry at exactly the same age
checked: Real Madrid at AEK Athens, 4 Nov 2026 (UEFA + Foot Africa fixture lists). Mbappé b. 20 Dec 1998 = 27y 319d that day; Henry b. 17 Aug 1977 reached 27y 319d on 2 Jul 2005 (summer, so season totals are exact). Henry league: Monaco 105/20, Juventus 16/3, Arsenal 1999-2005 205/137 (Wikipedia infobox 254/174 to 2007 minus 2005-06 32/27 and 2006-07 17/10; per-season goals 17,17,24,24,30,25 match FourFourTwo) = 326 games, 160 goals. Golden Boots 2002, 2004, 2005; World Cup 1998, Euro 2000; PL 2002 and 2004 (Wikipedia). Arsenal PL record 175. Mbappé league to 1 Nov 2026: Monaco 41/16, PSG 27/13 + 178/162, Real Madrid 76/68 = 322 games, 259 goals, reserves left out (Wikipedia career table). World Cup 2018 winner; Golden Boots 2022 and 2026, first to win two (ESPN, worldcupranking); European Golden Shoe 2024-25 (Wikipedia). Clásico 25 Oct 2026: Mbappé both goals in a 2-1 win, winner on 87' from Camavinga after he drew the keeper (AP via TSN and La Nación). No Henry gameplay: the Highbury volley v United (1 Oct 2000) is known, but neither side's kit could be confirmed, so it is not recreated.

lines.text: Kylian Mbappé against Thierry Henry. France's two greatest strikers, at exactly the same age.
lines.say: Keelian Embapay against Tyerree Onree. France's two greatest strikers, at exactly the same age.

lines.text: When Real Madrid play in Athens on the fourth of November, Mbappé is twenty-seven years and 319 days old.
lines.say: When Real Madrid play in Athens on the fourth of November, Embapay is twenty-seven years and three hundred and nineteen days old.

lines.text: Henry hit that age in July 2005. A World Cup, a Euro, two league titles, and the Invincibles behind him.
lines.say: Onree hit that age in July twenty oh-five. A World Cup, a Euro, two league titles, and the Invincibles behind him.

lines.text: At Arsenal he scored seventeen, seventeen, twenty-four, twenty-four, thirty and twenty-five league goals.
Add Monaco and Juventus, and that's 160 league goals at that age.
lines.say: Add Monaco and Yooventus, and that's a hundred and sixty league goals at that age.
Embapay at the same age? Two hundred and fifty-nine.

lines.text: Ninety-nine more. That's more than Henry's whole Premier League record for Arsenal.
lines.say: Ninety-nine more. That's more than Onree's whole Premier League record for Arsenal.

lines.text: Maybe Mbappé just played more? No. Henry had played 326 league games. Mbappé, 322.
lines.say: Maybe Embapay just played more? No. Onree had played three hundred and twenty-six league games. Embapay, three hundred and twenty-two.

lines.text: The reason? Henry started out on the wing. Twenty-three league goals at Monaco and Juve, before Wenger made him a striker.
lines.say: The reason? Onree started out on the wing. Twenty-three league goals at Monaco and Yoovay, before Wenger made him a striker.

lines.text: And Mbappé keeps going. Last month at Camp Nou, he scored twice and won the Clásico three minutes from time.
lines.say: And Embapay keeps going. Last month at Camp Noo, he scored twice and won the Klasseeko three minutes from time.

lines.text: He's a World Cup winner, the European Golden Shoe winner, and the first man to win two World Cup Golden Boots.
lines.say: He's a World Cup winner, the European Golden Shoe winner, and the first man to win two World Cup Golden Boots.

lines.text: So who's the greatest French striker ever? Henry, or Mbappé?
lines.say: So who's the greatest French striker ever? Onree, or Embapay?

lines.text: Follow for more, and play Road to Ballon d'Or.
